TZ=UTC mysqlbinlog \
  --stop-datetime='2030-01-01 00:00:00' \
  $DATA/1/mysql-bin.000003 \
  $DATA/1/mysql-bin.000004 \
  $DATA/1/mysql-bin.000005 \
  $DATA/1/mysql-bin.000006 \
  $DATA/1/mysql-bin.000007.open.e1
# Pipe stdout to mysql in this same shell so pipefail sees a client failure.

# Verify: mysql -Nse 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM db.tbl; SELECT @@gtid_executed'
